ambient_events: Somebody stops on the kerb to retie a shoe.
A street sweeper goes by on Sorrel Way with its brushes up.
A sparrow lands on the kerb, finds nothing and goes.
description: Four young trees on a mulch bed beside Kimble's Souvenirs & Cards. Two posts from an old Halcyon plot board are still in the ground, with a sticker on one of them.
name: Sorrel Gardens
